subject: Demo matrix and stakeholder onboarding for Pilot
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed demo windows and stakeholders

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to learn more about Finovate's payments latency constraints and the multi-tenant isolation requirement. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Recap: goal is a 6-week pilot to validate 95th percentile latency < 150ms for typical payment flows, and a customer-data isolation proof for audit.
- Next meeting: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive + demo where we show performance profiles, KV cache behavior, and a short integration checklist.
- Stakeholders: would like to include your security lead and procurement to align on evidence and commercial path. From our side, Marissa (platform lead) will own the demo; Sergio will be on procurement terms.

Proposed demo windows (all PDT):
1) Tue 10/06 10:00–11:15
2) Wed 10/07 13:00–14:15
3) Thu 10/08 09:00–10:15

Please confirm which slot works and who from your side should join (security, SRE, procurement). I attached a short Mutual Action Plan draft and a demo matrix to help pick the agenda.

If there are additional constraints (firewalls, VPC access patterns), call them out and we’ll prep a separate notes doc.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0189 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (14 KB), Demo_Matrix.xlsx (8 KB)

Looking forward to Marissa’s demo.
